answer: The system issues each new agent a cryptographic token whose proof‑of‑work is a marble‑strength hash that must be recomputed in a spiral of increasing difficulty; the token also embeds a signed cedar‑derived public key that only a verified node can generate. When a node receives a request, it challenges the claimant with a random puzzle tied to that token; only the original holder can solve it within a bounded time, otherwise the request is dropped.
